question:

FEUDALS : DUEFSLA :: FREIGHT : IERFTHG :: QUARTER : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is as follows:

FEUDALS : DUEFSLA

FREIGHT : IERFTHG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b1abaed9c80a60fb039e1edeaa83b16c959498c4675b9ab6a38054fd00f7952.png] 

Similarly, QUARTER : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/335318ecc51b2f29921732ecc8bf59fc11c23cddd501d8342b4506307dd66a70.png]
